newsitem.title: PERU: Peru May tax revenues rise 3.1 pct over year-ago.
newsitem.headline: Peru May tax revenues rise 3.1 pct over year-ago.

text.p: Peru's tax revenues in May were 1.853 billion soles, 3.1 percent higher in real terms than the same month last year, the National Superintendency of Tax Administration (SUNAT) said Monday.
Tax revenues for the first five months of the year were 9.581 billion soles, up 3.5 percent in real terms from the same period last year, SUNAT added in its monthly report.
Tax revenues rose 4.9 percent in real terms during 1996 to 19.94 billion soles.
